name: Nadiral-Psalter
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around active supervolcanoes, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on exotic matter, iron and copper are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
